Sub: Grant of exemption from the provisions of EDLI Scheme, 1976 under Section
17(2A) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952

Sir,

As you are aware that exemption*of EDLI U/s 17(2A) of the Act is an important area
where the respective RPFCs need to take personal interest to submit the proposal in time.
However, it is observed that for last one year no proposals have come to Headquarter for grant
of EDLI exemption. It seems it is an area that requires due attention. In order to understand
the issues and problems in this area of functioning, it is decided to have a meeting of Officers
In-charge of the above said offices along-with respective ACCs on 12" May 2014 at 11.00 a.m.
in Mini Conference Hall, 2 Floor, Head Office, New Delhi. You are requested to make it
convenient to attend the meeting along with following details in respect of your offices:-
